title: The Midnight Inheritance
description: A stranger dies and leaves you a manor on the hill. The will has one condition: you must spend the first night inside.

n1.caption: Rain hammers the windshield as the solicitor hands you a single iron key. The manor waits on the hill.

choices.label: Drive up to the manor tonight
Read the letter he left you first

n2a.caption: The gates open on their own. Inside, eight candles are lit — but the house has been empty for years.

n2b.caption: The letter contains one sentence: 'Do not let them know you can see them.'

choices.label: Burn the letter and drive up anyway

n3a.caption: At the top of the stairs, a portrait of a woman in black. Her eyes have been scratched out — from the inside of the frame.

n3b.caption: In the study drawer: a guest list. Every name is crossed out except yours — written in fresh ink.

n3c.caption: The solicitor answers on the first ring. 'You opened the letter,' he says. 'Then you already know you're not the heir. You're the invitation.'
